title: JATA-RB-v0.1-PROPOSED assessment manifest row schema (NOT ADOPTED — PROPOSAL ONLY)
description: Machine-readable contract for RB baseline manifest rows. Template rows use UNASSESSED sentinels and blank derived fields. A completed assessment row (only post-adoption, if ever) must satisfy all enums, exact-fraction patterns, and cross-field identities. This schema performs no scoring.

unit_weight_points_exact.description: Exact unit weight in rubric points: 13/8 for D01-D06/D08-D15 units (NEW/PROPOSED); 9/4 for D07 units (PRESERVED value, NEW/PROPOSED extension to D07a/c/d).

unit_weight_points_decimal.description: Display only; never used in comparisons.

C_value_exact.description: Must equal the C_level mapping when assessed; blank when UNASSESSED.

C_citation.description: File path + line span or test ID at the assessed SHA; required when assessed.

I_value_exact.description: Must equal the I_level mapping when assessed; blank when UNASSESSED.

I_citation.description: Composition path + test ID at the assessed SHA; required when assessed.

E_coeff_exact.description: Must equal the E_class mapping when assessed; blank when UNASSESSED.

evidence_artifact.description: Committed path(s) of the evidence; required when assessed (except E0 with a recorded rationale).

evidence_sha.description: Full 40-hex SHA of the assessed artifact; required when assessed.

freshness_age_days.description: Whole days t_a - t_e; blank when UNASSESSED.

f_value_exact.description: Must equal the decay-table mapping for freshness_age_days (and SHA match) when assessed.

Q_value_exact.description: Exact fraction string a/b; must equal E_coeff * f when assessed; blank when UNASSESSED.

q_value_exact.description: Exact fraction string a/b; must equal C*I*Q when assessed (D07b per-modality rule instead); blank when UNASSESSED.

points_earned_exact.description: Exact fraction string a/b; must equal unit_weight * q when assessed; blank when UNASSESSED.

assessor.description: Assessor identity; UNASSESSED in the template.
